title: Beef Stroganoff

items: 2.5 lbs beef chuck, trimmed and sliced
1 Tbsp beef concentrate + 1.5 cups water (or 3 cups beef broth simmered until reduced by half)
1 tsp Diamond Crystal kosher salt, or ½ tsp Morton kosher or table salt, initially; more to taste
½ tsp freshly ground black pepper

steps: Put 2 Tbsp caraway seeds in ¼ cup boiling water and set aside for later.
Season the beef with salt and pepper then toss with flour.
Set the Instant Pot to Saute-High and add 3 Tbsp of oil. Fry the beef for 5 minutes or until golden brown.
Stir in the chopped onion, garlic, tomato paste, paprika, and broth.
Pressure cook for 35 minutes at high pressure then quick release.
Stir in the parsley, dill, and mushrooms then cover and simmer for another 10 minutes with the Keep Warm setting.
Meanwhile, bring a pot of salted water to boil.
Cook the fettuccini noodles, drain, then toss with butter.
Thin the sour cream with the liquid from the strained caraway seeds, and stir into the pot.
reviewFlags: Suggested flour, tomato paste, salt, and pepper quantities are awaiting review. The flour lightly coats the beef and adds body. Tomato paste adds savory depth. Start conservatively with salt because the beef concentrate may already be salty, then adjust the finished sauce. The pepper amount is a moderate starting point.
